{{Short description|Chinese physicist (born 1963)}}{{Distinguish|text=military officer [[Chen Xianhua]]}}{{family name hatnote|[[Chen (surname)|Chen]]|lang=Chinese}}

'''Chen Xianhui''' ({{zh|s=陈仙辉|p=Chén Xīanhuī}}; born March 8, 1963) is a Chinese physicist. He is a Changjiang professor of physics of the [[University of Science and Technology of China]] (USTC). He was elected an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS) in 2015 and is known for his breakthroughs on [[iron-based superconductors]].<ref>{{cite journal|author1=X. H. Chen |author2=T. Wu |author3=G. Wu |author4=R. H. Liu |author5=H. Chen |author6=D. F. Fang |title=Superconductivity at 43 K in Samarium-arsenide Oxides SmFeAsO1-xFx|journal=Nature |year=2008 |volume= 453 |issue=7196 |pages=761–762 |doi=10.1038/nature07045 |bibcode= 2008Natur.453..761C|arxiv=0803.3603 |pmid=18500328|s2cid=205213713 }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|author1=R. H. Liu |author2=T. Wu |author3=G. Wu |author4=H. Chen |author5=X. F. Wang |author6=Y. L. Xie |author7=J. J. Yin |author8=Y. J. Yan |author9=Q. J. Li |author10=B. C. Shi |author11=W. S. Chu |author12=Z. Y. Wu |title=A large iron isotope effect in SmFeAsO1-xFx and Ba1-xKxFe2As2|journal=Nature |year=2009 |volume= 459 |issue=7243 |pages=64–67 |doi=10.1038/nature07981 |pmid=19424151 |bibcode=2009Natur.459...64L |arxiv=0810.2694|s2cid=4423594 }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|author1=T. Y. Chen |author2=Z. Tesanovic |author3=R. H. Liu |author4=X. H. Chen |author5=C. L. Chien |title=The BCS like gap in superconductor SmFeAsO0.85F0.15|journal=Nature |year=2008 |volume= 453 |issue=7199 |pages=1224–1227 |doi=10.1038/nature07081 |bibcode=2008Natur.453.1224C |arxiv= 0805.4616|pmid=18528330|s2cid=4370914 }}</ref> He won the [[State Natural Science Award]] (First Class) with [[Zhao Zhongxian]] and others in 2013 and the [[Bernd T. Matthias Prize]] for Superconducting Materials in 2015.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://en.hfnl.ustc.edu.cn/Faculty/Facultys/201107/t20110715_116142.html |title=CHEN Xianhui--Hefei National Laboratory for Physical Sciences at the Microscale |website=en.hfnl.ustc.edu.cn |access-date=2016-03-05 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160306103508/http://en.hfnl.ustc.edu.cn/Faculty/Facultys/201107/t20110715_116142.html |archive-date=2016-03-06 |url-status=dead }}</ref> His research is mainly on experimental [[condensed matter physics]] and materials science. In 2016, he became a laureate of the [[Asian Scientist 100]] by the ''[[Asian Scientist]]''.
